evidence.detail: PR 'Fix issues with achievements that should show other people's decks' — fixes bug 1 (checked in issue body)

Show active league runs in achievement tables — adds prepare_decks() override to PersonAchievements at decksite/views/person_achievements.py:18-23, properly propagating hide_active_runs to each achievement detail and calling prepare_active_runs; in master as of Aug 21 2026; addresses the 'hiding active league runs even from admins' part of bug 2
hide_active_runs = not session.get('admin', False) — only admin flag is checked, not deck ownership; non-admin owners still get active runs moved to summary text
Bug 3 (tournaments entered count vs decks shown is one off) remains unchecked and unverified; may relate to active-run hiding producing a visible count mismatch for non-admins

triage.notes: Bug 2 appears substantially addressed by 0d0ba9dd (in master). Bug 3 (one-off count) is still unverified: the active-run text now accounts for hidden decks but the achievement legend count (from SQL) and the visible deck list could still appear mismatched for non-admins with an active run qualifying for the achievement.
